native_classification: ERRANT types attached to W&I human revision edits; automatically assigned category, native annotator identity retained

unsupported_categories.reason: Agreement and tense correction are outside the existing bounded prose-pattern contracts.
Article edits do not by category alone establish repeated-function-word or other linter violations.
Spelling and orthographic correction categories do not establish an existing specific rule contract.
Broad edit classes require a contextual judgment; they do not identify a rule violation or clean source.
No independently reviewed exact category-to-rule equivalence is established. A noop is an annotator alternative, not exhaustive linter coverage.

coordinate_contract: Native token offsets map only to the unchanged visible tokenized sentence. Do not detokenize, collapse alternate annotators or infer corrections as clean negatives.
annotation_policy: An empty supported mapping is intentional. Independent human issue/coverage labels remain deferred; source packet exports never promote native edit types into expected findings.
